prompts.prompt: Wide shot from the upper tier of a Stockholm ice hockey arena, the brightly lit rink below framed by a packed crowd in winter coats. Players in contrasting jerseys warm up near the goal crease as the pre-game atmosphere builds.

Medium shot of two amateur boxers exchanging punches inside a roped ring at a Stockholm sports hall, their bare torsos glistening with sweat under overhead gymnasium lights. Coaches and a small audience of friends watch from folding chairs along the perimeter.

Wide view of Solvalla's oval trotting track on a grey Stockholm afternoon, the dirt course stretching past white railing toward a low clubhouse and modest grandstand. A handful of spectators in jackets linger along the inner fence.
Close-up of a pair of well-worn running shoes resting on damp cobblestones, lit by soft late-summer evening light, with blurred runners passing in the background of a Stockholm city race finish area.
